Name: Carpentry Catalogue (and Blacksmith Bulletins) - aka Custom Builders
Author: zombifier
Description:
This mod does a few things things:

[size=4][b]FOR USERS:
[/b][/size]This mod improves the carpenter menu with the following features:
[list]
[*]Adds a new button to Robin/Wizard's build menu that pulls up a catalogue of every building, making for much easier scrolling and building selections
[/list]Especially useful if you have lots of buildings (like with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32564]HxW All In One Pack[/url] which is showcased in the screenshot)

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33271]Compact Searchable Shop Menu[/url] for an even more compact icon view!
[list]
[*]Allows buildings with more than 3 ingredients to display properly via scrolling
[/list]
[size=4][b]FOR MOD AUTHORS:[/b][/size]
This framework mod allows adding:
[list]
[*]Extra Robin-like carpenter NPCs, which can construct buildings for you, complete with hammer animations. Supports shared buildings with Robin alongside their own buildings, with custom cost/days from Robin's own.
[*]Extra Clint-like blacksmith NPCs, which can upgrade your tools or weapons or even deliver items (like, say, 20 preserves jars) after a few days. The tools and weapons inherit any enchantments or attachments.
[*]Extra geode smasher NPCs other than Clint.
[*]Extra trade items for a shop entry
[*]Ability to open a custom map menu containing multiple entries; you can use this to have one single tile offer a carpenter service, one or multiple shops, blacksmith service, or more.
[/list]
Installation Instructions For Users:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and extract the zip into the Mods folder inside the game's directory.
[/list]
(NOTE: The framework does nothing on its own. Another mod will have to replicate the Leah screenshot.)

[url=https://github.com/zombifier/My_Stardew_Mods/tree/master/CustomBuilders]Source and Modder Guide[/url]

Manifest.Name: Carpentry Catalogue (and Blacksmith Bulletin)
Manifest.Description: Adds a button that allows scrolling through buildings in a convenient list, and allows specifying custom carpenters/blacksmith NPCs with their own menus and costs.
